newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH WIG SEEN AT 16,832 AT YEAR-END - POLL.
newsitem.headline: POLISH WIG SEEN AT 16,832 AT YEAR-END - POLL.

text.p: Polish brokers expect the Warsaw bourse's main WIG index to reach 16,832 points by the end of the year, the financial daily Nowa Europa said on Monday.
In mid-August the monthly survey's year-end prediction was at 15,118 points. The predictions this month ranged between 14,850 points and 19,500 points, it said.

Brokers also expected the main market to reach 18,127 points in mid-1997 and 20,723 points at the end of next year, as opposed to a month ago when they saw the WIG at 15,200 points at the end of 1997.
